Prior feasible throughput trajectories using uncompressed chunks measured about 169.77 and 171.87 samples/s, and an uncompressed grouped-variables variant measured 174.28 samples/s, while compressed LZ4/Zstd variants were much lower. Because p011 failed when attempting this from p010, the replacement prompt must be explicit about preserving contract validation, Zarr v3 consolidated publication, dataset_artifact declarations, pressure-level selector dimensions, offline fixture verification, deterministic rerun behavior, and tests; it must also avoid introducing framework-owned files observed in the parent source listing.
